title: Azumanga Daioh
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: This four-panel comedy follows six girls through three years of high school: child prodigy Chiyo, spacey Osaka, hyperactive Tomo, exasperated Yomi, shy animal-lover Sakaki and sporty Kagura. Tests, culture festivals, sports days and beach trips fill the pages, with their teachers Yukari and Kimura adding chaos. It ends with the class's graduation.
life_message: It holds up ordinary friendship and small daily joys as enough to make a good life.
